title: CALL FOR ARTISTS
content: CALL FOR ARTISTS Calling artists, illustrators, designers and creatives! The Town of Gravenhurst, in collaboration with the Gravenhurst BIA Review Steering Committee, is seeking an artist to create an original Fall in Muskoka artwork that will become a large-scale interactive photo-op in downtown Gravenhurst. We’re looking for something creative, bold, welcoming and unmistakably Muskoka – think fall colours, lakes, landscapes, wildlife, recreation, local character and everything that makes autumn in Muskoka special. Artist Commission: $1,000 + HST Final Installation: Approx. 4 ft. x 8 ft. author: Abdulquadri Saka
title: Life Update!!!
content: Life Update!!! I’ve been admiring works related to illustration for a long time, and I finally took a bold step towards learning it. I’ve been sharing my journey on other platforms, and I thought I’d drop it here too. So, yeah! Call me an Illustrator if you want to… It’s been an amazing journey, to be honest. Excluding the crazy part of struggling with shapes and lines and almost breaking my PC, lol. . I also learnt something from Ufot Ubon, a top illustrator. He made a tweet on X saying: You don’t become a better illustrator by drawing more complicated things. You become better by learning how to make complicated things look simple. And to be honest, it has been helpful. . . Enjoy these slides to see some of my beautiful creations. It’s worth it. Don’t miss slide 19. It was a hell of work. And, if you need an Illustrator, or you’ve been looking to infuse illustration into your branding, give me a chance to. Don’t fret, I’m on my way to becoming a PRO. Send me a DM or mail to workwithabdulquadri@gmail.com, let’s come up with something sweet. #illustrator #illustration #branding #branddesigner #digitalillustration

author: @blvckhelicoptersv4.0
title: LOOKING FOR ARTISTS
content: LOOKING FOR ARTISTS BLVCKHELICOPTERS is seeking established artists interested in creating a series of original posters for the project. Rather than handing you a detailed visual brief, I want to give you room to approach the project from your own perspective. I'll provide the music, ideas behind BLVCKHELICOPTERS, and some background, then leave the artistic direction to you. I want to see your interpretation of the project, not an imitation of an existing aesthetic. This would be a paid commission, with 50% paid when the project begins and the remaining 50% upon completion. Payment is made through PayPal only, no exceptions. Commercial use of the finished artwork will be discussed and agreed upon beforehand, and the artist will receive proper credit on the poster and related promotional material. There will also be an optional promotional bonus. If you choose to promote the finished poster through your own page, you'll receive 50% of the net profits generated by that poster during its first 30 days of sales. I'm particularly interested in artists who already have a distinctive style and an established body of work. I don't want every BLVCKHELICOPTERS poster to come from the same visual perspective. Part of the appeal is seeing how different artists interpret the project. If we work well together and I like what you create, I'd also be interested in developing the relationship beyond one commission and potentially building an ongoing creative partnership. HUMAN ART ONLY. I use AI-assisted tools in making BLVCKHELICOPTERS music, and I'm transparent about that. But when I'm commissioning visual art, I specifically want the work to come from a real artist's own vision, style, and creative process. Due to the volume of submissions, I may not be able to respond individually to everyone who reaches out. If I think your work would be a good fit, I'll follow up with you directly. Interested? DM me or email me with your portfolio and a little about yourself. Email is preferred for serious inquiries. Email: blvckhelicopters@gmail.com #antistate #anarchist #art #artcommission #artistwanted
